about: CHK-12 (R-12): the reviewed mentions of a push tool (supabase, drizzle-kit) in Node, TypeScript and workflow files. Each mention is pinned by the sha256 of the line that holds it, so a new mention or a changed mentioning line needs a review; a file not listed has none. scripts/ci/schema-push-search.test.mjs enforces it. This is a mistake-prevention check: it catches an accidental push invocation, not a deliberately disguised one.
